seed_fact: Post-launch support (30 days minimum) should be in the contract. Bugs always appear.
image_headline: Your Site Needs 30 Days of Care
caption:
Launching a new website isn’t the finish line—it’s the start of real results. I always include at least 30 days of post‑launch support because bugs appear once the site goes live, and fixing them quickly keeps customers happy. DM me to discuss a smooth launch for your business.
